doctor_on_call.name: Doctor on Call
doctor_on_call.description: 24/7 access to a certified doctor via phone or video call from anywhere in the world
doctor_on_call.suitable_for: All travellers — especially families and senior citizens

air_ambulance.name: Air Ambulance
air_ambulance.description: Emergency medical evacuation by air to the nearest suitable hospital or back home
highlights: Repatriation to home country if needed
air_ambulance.suitable_for: Travellers visiting remote areas or countries with poor medical infrastructure

travel_concierge.name: Travel Concierge
travel_concierge.description: Dedicated 24/7 concierge support for bookings, emergencies, and travel assistance
travel_concierge.suitable_for: Business travellers and first-time international travellers

roadside_assistance.name: Roadside Assistance
roadside_assistance.description: On-ground vehicle breakdown and roadside help at your travel destination
roadside_assistance.suitable_for: Travellers planning road trips or hiring rental cars

mental_health_support.name: Mental Health Support
mental_health_support.description: Access to licensed therapists and counsellors via phone or video during your trip
mental_health_support.suitable_for: Solo travellers, long-stay travellers, or those prone to travel anxiety

emergency_cash.name: Emergency Cash Assistance
emergency_cash.description: Same-day emergency cash transfer if you lose your wallet or are robbed abroad

visa_assistance.name: Visa & Entry Assistance
visa_assistance.description: Expert guidance and documentation support for visa applications and entry requirements
visa_assistance.suitable_for: Travellers applying for complex visas (Schengen, US, UK)

lounge_access.name: Airport Lounge Access
lounge_access.description: Single-visit airport lounge access at departure and arrival airports
lounge_access.suitable_for: Long-haul or business travellers wanting comfort during layovers

pharmacy_delivery.name: Pharmacy on Demand
pharmacy_delivery.description: Same-day prescription medicine delivery to your hotel anywhere in major cities
pharmacy_delivery.suitable_for: Travellers on regular medication or with chronic conditions

repatriation_remains.name: Mortal Remains Repatriation
repatriation_remains.description: Covers the full cost of repatriating mortal remains to the home country in the event of death abroad
repatriation_remains.suitable_for: Elderly travellers or those with serious medical conditions
